located_point.method: Not located in imagery. The site index point (23.198333, 69.441944, Wikidata 'Desalpur', a village) falls on a modern town beside a highway. Indian Archaeology 1963-64 places the excavated site, Desalpur (Gunthli), in Taluka Nakhatrana on the river Dhrud, and Bhan and Ajithprasad's Shikarpur 2007-2008 report lists 'Gunthali (Desalpur)' at 23 deg 30' 22.60" N, 69 deg 12' 02.89" E, about 35 km north-west of the index point; that printed coordinate is given here as the best available location. It lies outside the held imagery window.

sources.imagery_result: no lines: the held window (latitude 23.176-23.221, longitude 69.417-69.466) is centred on a homonymous modern village and does not cover the coordinate printed for the Harappan site

notes: The plan library holds no plan for Desalpur. We searched the held Indian Archaeology 1963-64 (data/raw/2026-10-06-evidence-census/sites-deep/b-gujarat-kutch-maharashtra/IAR1963-1964-ALT.pdf, PDF pages 19-20, item 19 'Excavation at Desalpur (Gunthli), District Kutch'): it describes a fortified site of 130 by 100 m with a rubble fortification, and refers only to photographic plates; it has no plan with a north arrow. A repeat needs imagery at the printed site coordinate and the full excavation report.
unmeasurable_reason: No plan with a north arrow found, and the held imagery window does not cover the site: it is centred on a homonymous village about 35 km from the coordinate printed for Desalpur (Gunthli).
